        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,

    })
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")

    end)

            return

        loadRecIntoEditor(recFromIcon(CL.ToIcon(rec), rec.Name), false)
        setStatus("Logo \"" .. rec.Name .. "\" cargado: tocá Crear logo para guardarlo", "Logo \"" .. rec.Name .. "\" loaded: tap Create logo to save it", Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120))
    end)

    -- =====================================================================
    -- ABRIR / CERRAR / GUARDAR
    -- =====================================================================
    local function stopLoop()
        if LS.loop then LS.loop:Disconnect() LS.loop = nil end
    end
    local function closeEditor()
        stopLoop()
        activeSlider = nil
        if LS.realLive then setRealLive(false) end
        setGhost(false)
        TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.94 }):Play()
        task.delay(0.15, function() Overlay.Visible = false end)
    end

    openEditor = function(id)
        ED.editingId = id
        local saved = id and CL.Logos[id]
        if saved then
            ED.rec = recFromIcon(CL.ToIcon(saved), saved.Name)
        else
            ED.rec = blankRec()
        end
        NameBox.Text = ED.rec.Name
        L(Title, saved and "Editar logo" or "Estudio de Logos", saved and "Edit logo" or "Logo Studio")
        L(SaveBtn, saved and "Guardar cambios" or "Crear logo", saved and "Save changes" or "Create logo")
        L(Status, "", "")
        rebuildLayerCards()
        refreshBaseCard()
        refreshSoundCard()
        setBackdrop(LS.backdrop)
        backdropChips.Set(LS.backdrop)
        zoomChips.Set(LS.zoom)
        applyZoom()
        Hint.Visible, Hint.TextTransparency, Hint.BackgroundTransparency = true, 0, 0.45
        Ghost.Visible, ghostOpen, Ghost.GroupTransparency = false, false, 1
        PvButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 52)
        Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        rebuildPreview()
        Overlay.Visible = true
        PanelScale.Scale = 0.94
        TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        stopLoop()
        -- la vista previa se anima solo mientras el editor está abierto
        LS.loop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            stepLayers(LS.live, dt)
        end)
    end

    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeEditor)
    CancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeEditor)
    SaveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        ED.rec.Name = NameBox.Text:sub(1, 24)
        if ED.rec.Name:match("^%s*$") then
            setStatus("Ponele un nombre a tu logo", "Give your logo a name", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            NameBox:CaptureFocus()
            return
        end
        local saved = recToSaved(ED.rec, ED.editingId or CL.NewId())
        if not saved then
            setStatus("Falta la imagen: pegá un ID en la capa 1", "Missing image: paste an ID in layer 1", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            return
        end
        local okSave, err = CL.Put(saved)
        if err == "max" then
            setStatus("Llegaste al máximo de " .. CL.Max .. " logos: borrá uno primero", "You reached the max of " .. CL.Max .. " logos: delete one first", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            return
        end
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        local key = CL.Key(saved.Id)
        SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = key
        SaveConfig()
        if LS.realLive then
            setRealLive(false) -- vuelve a dibujar SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon (el nuevo)
        else
            ApplyLogoIcon(key)
        end
        LS.RefreshCards()
        for _, other in ipairs(LP.cards) do
            LP.paint(other, other.key == key, true)
        end
        LP.setHero(key)
        closeEditor()
        if not okSave then
            warn("[YinYang Logos] Tu ejecutor no tiene writefile: el logo dura hasta que cierres el juego")
        end
    end)

    -- =====================================================================
    -- PREMIUM (gamepass "Yin Yang Studio Logos"): crear / editar logos
    -- =====================================================================
    -- El gamepass queda en la CUENTA de Roblox: se consulta a Roblox cada vez que carga el script
    -- (cualquier dispositivo, cualquier ejecutor). El archivo local solo se usa si Roblox no responde.
    local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
    local PR = { owned = false, checking = true, listeners = {}, price = nil }
    local PASS_ID = PremiumConfig.GamepassId
    local PASS_URL = "https://www.roblox.com/game-pass/" .. tostring(PASS_ID)

    local function readCache()
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            if isfile and readfile and isfile(PremiumConfig.CacheFile) then
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(PremiumConfig.CacheFile))
            end
            return nil
        end)
        return ok and type(data) == "table" and data.UserId == LocalPlayer.UserId and data.Pass == PASS_ID and data.Owned == true
    end
    local function writeCache(owned)
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                writefile(PremiumConfig.CacheFile, HttpService:JSONEncode({ UserId = LocalPlayer.UserId, Pass = PASS_ID, Owned = owned == true, At = os.time() }))
            end
        end)
    end
    function PR.set(owned, fromApi)
        PR.owned = owned == true
        PR.checking = false
        if fromApi then writeCache(PR.owned) end
        for _, fn in ipairs(PR.listeners) do pcall(fn, PR.owned) end
    end
    local function isOwnerName()
        local me = string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name)
        for _, n in ipairs(PremiumConfig.Owners or {}) do
            if string.lower(tostring(n)) == me then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function PR.check()
        PR.checking = true
        for _, fn in ipairs(PR.listeners) do pcall(fn, PR.owned) end
        task.spawn(function()
            if isOwnerName() then PR.set(true, false) return end
            local okOwn, owns = false, nil
            for attempt = 1, 3 do
                okOwn, owns = pcall(function()
                    return MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(LocalPlayer.UserId, PASS_ID)
                end)
                if okOwn then break end
                task.wait(attempt * 1.5)
            end
            -- el creador del pase siempre tiene acceso (aunque no se lo haya "comprado")
            local okInfo, info = pcall(function()
                return MPS:GetProductInfo(PASS_ID, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
            end)
            if okInfo and type(info) == "table" then
                PR.price = tonumber(info.PriceInRobux)
                local creator = info.Creator
                if type(creator) == "table" and tonumber(creator.CreatorTargetId) == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    owns, okOwn = true, true
                end
            end
            if okOwn then
                PR.set(owns == true, true)
            else
                -- Roblox no respondió: se usa la última verificación buena de esta cuenta
                PR.set(readCache(), false)
            end
        end)
    end
    -- compra terminada dentro del juego: se desbloquea al instante
    pcall(function()
        MPS.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
            if player == LocalPlayer and tonumber(passId) == PASS_ID and purchased then
                PR.set(true, true)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ---------- candado dibujado (arco + cuerpo) ----------
    local GOLD_A, GOLD_B = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)
    local function goldGradient(parent, rotation)
        return mk("UIGradient", { Parent = parent, Rotation = rotation or 45, Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD_A, GOLD_B) })
    end
    local function drawLock(parent, px, z)
        local holder = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z })
        local shackle = mk("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.62), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.02), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z })
        corner(shackle, 999)
        local ss = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = shackle, Color = WHITE, Thickness = math.max(2, px * 0.1) })
        goldGradient(ss, 90)
        local body = mk("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.56), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 1 })
        corner(body, math.max(3, math.floor(px * 0.14)))
        goldGradient(body, 90)
        local hole = mk("Frame", { Parent = body, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.16, 0.36), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 34, 8), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 2 })
        corner(hole, 999)
        return holder
    end

    -- =================== DEMOSTRACIÓN ANIMADA ===================
    -- Un mini estudio que se arma solo: ID -> imagen, movimiento, colores, guardar.
    -- Corre solo mientras la ventana premium está abierta (tweens nativos + una corrutina).
    -- Va en su propia función: BuildLogoStudio está cerca del límite de 200 locales de Luau.
    local startDemo, stopDemo = (function()
    local Demo = mk("Frame", { Parent = PBody, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 1, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.25, -3, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = Z + 2 })

    corner(Demo, 14)
    vgrad(Demo, Color3.fromRGB(78, 150, 232), Color3.fromRGB(176, 220, 252))
    local DemoStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = Demo, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.2 })
    goldGradient(DemoStroke, 45)
    local DZ = Z + 3
    local function dframe(props)
        props.Parent = props.Parent or Demo
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        props.ZIndex = props.ZIndex or DZ
        return mk("Frame", props)
    end
    local function dtext(parent, txt, size, color, props)
        local t = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = parent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = txt, TextColor3 = color or WHITE, TextSize = size, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = false, ZIndex = DZ + 2 })
        t:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do t[k] = v end
        return t
    end
    -- paisaje
    for _, m in ipairs({ { 0.2, 0.7 }, { 0.62, 0.9 }, { 0.95, 0.6 } }) do
        dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(m[2] * 0.6, m[2] * 0.6), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(m[1], 0.74), Rotation = 45, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 128, 170), ZIndex = DZ })
    end
    local dGround = dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.72), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = DZ + 1 })
    vgrad(dGround, Color3.fromRGB(112, 186, 104), Color3.fromRGB(58, 118, 62))

    -- mini panel del estudio (arriba): campo de ID + chips + colores + guardar
    local dPanel = dframe({ Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.3, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.04), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, ZIndex = DZ + 2 })

    corner(dId, 6)

    local demoGen = 0
    local ringTween = nil
    -- posición (en el cuadrado) del centro de un elemento del mini panel
    local function centerOf(el)
        if el.Parent == dPanel then
            local p = el.Position
            -- dPanel: x 0.04..0.96, y 0.04..0.34 del cuadrado
            return UDim2.new(0.04 + p.X.Scale * 0.92, 0, 0.04 + (p.Y.Scale + 0.17) * 0.3, 0)
        end
        return el.Position
    end
    local function demoReset()
        if ringTween then ringTween:Cancel() ringTween = nil end
        dIdText.Text = "ID: "
        dBase.ImageTransparency, dRing.ImageTransparency, dRing.Rotation = 1, 1, 0
        dRing.ImageColor3 = WHITE
        dBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
        dBtn.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.58)
        dBtnScale.Scale = 1
        chipSpin.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60)
        dToast.Visible = false
        dCaption.Text = ""
    end
    local function runDemo(gen)
        local function alive() return demoGen == gen and PSheet.Visible end
        local function pause(t)
            task.wait(t)
            return alive()
        end
        local function tap(el)
            TweenService:Create(dFinger, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = centerOf(el) }):Play()
            if not pause(0.5) then return false end
            TweenService:Create(dFingerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.08), { Scale = 0.65 }):Play()
            -- onda del toque
            local ring = dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = dFinger.Position, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = DZ + 9 })
            corner(ring, 999)
            local rs = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = ring, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2 })
            TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(rs, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            task.delay(0.45, function() ring:Destroy() end)
            if not pause(0.1) then return false end
            TweenService:Create(dFingerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            return pause(0.25)
        end
        local function caption(es, en)
            dCaption.Text = GetText(es, en)
        end
        while alive() do
            demoReset()
            if not pause(0.4) then break end
            -- 1) pegar el ID: aparece la imagen base
            caption("1 · Pegá el ID de tu imagen", "1 · Paste your image ID")
            if not tap(dId) then break end
            local id = "106130066496682"
            for i = 1, #id do
                dIdText.Text = "ID: " .. id:sub(1, i)
                if not pause(0.035) then break end
            end
            if not alive() then break end
            dBtnScale.Scale = 0.75
            TweenService:Create(dBase, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dBtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            if not pause(0.7) then break end
            -- 2) movimiento: el anillo aparece y gira
            caption("2 · Elegí un movimiento", "2 · Pick a movement")
            if not tap(chipSpin) then break end
            chipSpin.BackgroundColor3 = GOLD_B
            TweenService:Create(dRing, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
            ringTween = TweenService:Create(dRing, TweenInfo.new(2.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1), { Rotation = 360 })
            ringTween:Play()
            if not pause(1) then break end
            -- 3) colores: círculo rosa, anillo dorado
            caption("3 · Cambiá los colores", "3 · Change the colors")
            if not tap(swPink) then break end
            TweenService:Create(dBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 170) }):Play()
            if not pause(0.3) then break end
            if not tap(swGold) then break end
            TweenService:Create(dRing, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { ImageColor3 = GOLD_A }):Play()
            if not pause(0.7) then break end
            -- 4) guardar: cartel + el logo vuela a la esquina como botón flotante
            caption("4 · Guardalo y ¡listo!", "4 · Save it and done!")
            if not tap(chipSave) then break end
            dToast.Text = GetText("Guardado", "Saved")
            dToast.Visible = true
            dToastScale.Scale = 0.6
            TweenService:Create(dToastScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            if not pause(0.7) then break end
            dToast.Visible = false
            TweenService:Create(dBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.13, 0.45) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dBtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Scale = 0.6 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dFinger, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.9) }):Play()
            caption("Tu botón flotante, a tu gusto", "Your floating button, your way")
            if not pause(2.2) then break end
        end
    end
    local function startDemo()
        demoGen += 1
        task.spawn(runDemo, demoGen)
    end
    local function stopDemo()
        demoGen += 1
        if ringTween then ringTween:Cancel() ringTween = nil end
    end
    return startDemo, stopDemo
    end)()

    local function refreshBuyText()
        if PR.price then
            L(PBuyText, "Comprar · R$ " .. PR.price, "Buy · R$ " .. PR.price)
        else
            L(PBuyText, "Comprar en Roblox", "Buy on Roblox")
        end
    end
    local function closeSheet()
        TweenService:Create(PScale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.92 }):Play()
        task.delay(0.14, function() PSheet.Visible = false end)
        stopDemo()
    end
    local function showSheet()
        refreshBuyText()
        if PR.checking then
            L(PStatus, "Verificando tu cuenta...", "Checking your account...")
        else
            L(PStatus, "", "")
        end
        PSheet.Visible = true
        startDemo()
        PScale.Scale = 0.9
        TweenService:Create(PScale, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
    end
    PClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeSheet)
    PBuy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        local ok = pcall(function()
            MPS:PromptGamePassPurchase(LocalPlayer, PASS_ID)
        end)
        if type(setclipboard) == "function" then pcall(setclipboard, PASS_URL) end
        if ok then
            L(PStatus, "Se abrió la compra de Roblox · el link también quedó copiado", "Roblox purchase opened · link also copied")
        else
            L(PStatus, "Link copiado: compralo en el navegador y tocá Ya lo compré", "Link copied: buy it in the browser and tap I already bought it")
        end
    end)
    PCheck.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        L(PStatus, "Verificando tu cuenta...", "Checking your account...")
        PR.check()
    end)

    -- entrada única al editor: sin el pase se muestra la hoja premium
    local function guardedOpen(id)
        if PR.owned then
            openEditor(id)
        else
            showSheet()
        end
    end
    LS.Open = guardedOpen
    LS.Premium = PR
    FloatingPillV5.Studio.SetPremium(PR, showSheet) -- el mismo pase desbloquea el Estudio de Toggles Flotantes
    -- la hoja reacciona cuando termina una verificación o una compra
    table.insert(PR.listeners, function(owned)
        if not PSheet.Visible then return end
        refreshBuyText()
        if PR.checking then
            L(PStatus, "Verificando tu cuenta...", "Checking your account...")
        elseif owned then
            L(PStatus, "¡Listo! Ya tenés el Studio Logos", "Done! You now have Studio Logos")
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
            task.delay(0.9, closeSheet)
        else
            L(PStatus, "Todavía no figura la compra en tu cuenta", "The purchase isn't on your account yet")
        end
    end)

    local function header(order, es, en, subEs, subEn)
        local h = mk("Frame", { Parent = LogoPage, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 11 })
        local t = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = h, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 12 })
        t:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        L(t, es, en)
        local d = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = h, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 13), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 19), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 12 })
        d:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
        d:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        L(d, subEs, subEn)
        return h, d
    end

    header(9, "CATÁLOGO", "CATALOG", "Los íconos oficiales de Yin Yang", "Official Yin Yang icons")

    -- tarjeta "Crear": círculo con + y aro de colores girando
    do

            Parent = cs,
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.Accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.Accent),
            }),
        })
        TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(3.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1), { Rotation = 360 }):Play()
        local circle = mk("Frame", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 14), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, ZIndex = 13 })

        corner(lockBadge, 999)

        goldGradient(lbStroke, 45)
        drawLock(lockBadge, 13, 16)

    end

    local function customCard(id, rec, order)
        local key = CL.Key(id)
        local icon = IconCatalog.Icons[key]
        local c = mk("Frame", { Parent = MineGrid, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 12 })
        c:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(c, 14)
        local cStroke = stroke(c, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
        local sc = mk("UIScale", { Parent = c, Scale = 1 })
        local stage = mk("Frame", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 13 })
        stage:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(stage, 999)
        local ring = stroke(stage, Theme.Stroke, 2, 0.7)
        composite(stage, icon, 54, 14)
        local name = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 68), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = rec.Name, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 14 })
        name:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        local badge = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, Text = "", Visible = false, ZIndex = 15 })
        badge:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(badge, 999)
        RowKit.Icon(badge, 103456899356871, 12, 16, "AccentText")
        local hit = mk("TextButton", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = 16 })
        -- acciones: editar / borrar (borrar pide un segundo toque)
        local edit = mk("TextButton", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -26), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 17 })
        edit:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        edit:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        L(edit, "Editar", "Edit")
        corner(edit, 999)
        local del = mk("TextButton", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 1, -26), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 17 })
        del:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        del:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        L(del, "Borrar", "Delete")
        corner(del, 999)
        local entry = { card = c, stroke = cStroke, ring = ring, badge = badge, name = name, key = key, custom = true }
        LP.cards[#LP.cards + 1] = entry
        LP.paint(entry, SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon == key, false)
        hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            sc.Scale = 0.93
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = key
            SaveConfig()
            ApplyLogoIcon(key)
            for _, other in ipairs(LP.cards) do
                LP.paint(other, other.key == key, true)
            end
            LP.setHero(key)
        end)
        edit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            guardedOpen(id)
        end)
        local armed = false
        del.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not armed then
                armed = true
                L(del, "¿Seguro?", "Sure?")
                del.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 70)
                del.TextColor3 = WHITE
                task.delay(3, function()
                    if armed and del.Parent then
                        armed = false
                        L(del, "Borrar", "Delete")
                        del.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background
                        del.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
                    end
                end)
                return
            end
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            CL.Remove(id)
            if SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon == key then
                SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = "ClassicYinYang"
                SaveConfig()
                ApplyLogoIcon("ClassicYinYang")
                LP.setHero("ClassicYinYang")
                for _, other in ipairs(LP.cards) do
                    LP.paint(other, other.key == "ClassicYinYang", true)
                end
            end
            LS.RefreshCards()
        end)
    end

    function LS.RefreshCards()
        for i = #LP.cards, 1, -1 do
            if LP.cards[i].custom then
                LP.cards[i].card:Destroy()
                table.remove(LP.cards, i)
            end
        end
        for i, id in ipairs(CL.Order) do
            local rec = CL.Logos[id]
            if rec and IconCatalog.Icons[CL.Key(id)] then
                customCard(id, rec, i)
            end
        end
        local n = #CL.Order
        if n == 0 then
            L(MineSub, "Creá tu propio botón flotante con tus imágenes", "Create your own floating button with your images")
        else
            L(MineSub, n .. " de " .. CL.Max .. " · tocá uno para usarlo", n .. " of " .. CL.Max .. " · tap one to use it")
        end
    end
    LS.RefreshCards()
    LP.studio = LS
    PR.check()
    end
    BuildLogoStudio()

    local firstIcon = nil
    for i, name in ipairs(IconCatalog.Order or { "ClassicYinYang" }) do
        local data = IconCatalog.Icons[name]
        if data then
            firstIcon = firstIcon or name
            CreateIconCard(name, data, i)
        end
    end
    LP.setHero(IconCatalog.Icons[SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or ""] and SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or firstIcon)
    end
    BuildLogoTab()

    function Window:CreateClassicTab()
    local TabClassic = Window:CreateTab("Classic", "Classic", "rbxassetid://99086270459218")
    local
